01 / DREAMBUG / THREE PROOF FACTS
1

Two people read every book. Every title is reviewed by at least two people, line by line and picture by picture, before it can reach a child’s shelf.

Placeholder — Eleni's note goes here.

2

The library is in the app, not in the cloud. Every book is stored on the device at install, so the whole shelf works with the wifi switched off.

Placeholder — Eleni's note goes here.

3

“Data Not Collected”. That is the App Privacy answer on our own store page, and a parent can read it on Apple’s page without taking our word for it.
